IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: Alliance is a community organization working to build a more inclusive democracy so that all people can achieve their full potential in an environment of harmony, safety, equality, and justice. Alliance develops leaders, builds coalitions, advances policies, changes narratives, and mobilizes people on issues that matter most. Through this work, Alliance is making a greater impact to bring about equality in San Diego and beyond.

IRS990.Desc: Civic Engagement: Through its civic engagement program, Alliance is educating community members about how to participate in our democracy such as through voting. Alliance is also developing their skills as leaders, preparing them to speak to policymakers, to the media, and to their neighbors.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: Policy DevelopmentThrough its policy program, Alliance is identifying problems and developing solutions alongside affected community members in the border region. Our policy focus includes border enforcement policies, policing practices, housing, and other issues affecting human rights.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: Legal RightsThrough its legal rights program, Alliance is assisting immigrants to move down the pathway towards citizenship through such activities as know-your-rights sessions and application assistance workshops to help them become full participants in our democracy.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Alliance is a public charity and is exempt from income taxes under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code and Section 23701(d) of the California Revenue and Taxation Code. Alliance believes that it has appropriate support for any tax positions taken, and as such, does not have any uncertain tax positions that are material to the financial statements. Alliance is not a private foundation.Alliances Return of Organization Exempt from Income Tax for the year ended December 31, 2024, 2023, 2022 and 2021 are subject to examination by the Internal Revenue Service and State taxing authorities, generally three to four years after the returns were filed.
